m: The {Lifeguard} slides down the banister of the {Staircase} in the {Mansion}, blowing her whistle, but there is no banister, only a living *tree* with an *orchid* blooming on every branch. She snaps the branches into a neat **railing**, ties the orchids on as decorations, and leans on her new **railing** to watch the guests tumble down the stairs.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} onto a dusty *road* and sits on a *snapped stick* to wait. Bees, carriages and whole summers **pass by**, buzzing and rattling, and nobody stops. By sunset his beard reaches his boots, and he sighs that time just keeps **passing by**.

The {Cheerleader} sneaks through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} with her pom-poms muffled, scissors in hand. Deeper in the *cave* she *cuts* a hole in the sleeping yeti's sack and **steals** every snowball he owns. She cartwheels out chanting "Give me an S, give me a T!" while the yeti wakes to find someone **stole** his whole winter.

The {Yogi} rises out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} in a gown of woven *wheat*, a *rainbow* draped over her shoulders like a feather boa. Spotlights swing, cameras flash, and the butler swoons at how **glamorous** she is. Even holding a perfect lotus pose she looks utterly **glamorous**.

The {Chef} flings open the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and a green cloud of *stink* rolls out, wilting his tall hat. Inside, a week-old fish stew is bubbling by itself. Ducks paddle away, oars faint, and the whole lake turns **smelly**; even the Chef's moustache is **smelly** for a month.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} unspools a *silk thread* so **fine** you can barely see it. A *thousand ants* march along it single file, carrying coins across the gap to the next building. The thread is so **fine** that bankers below think the ants are walking on thin air.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} juggles pearls for a *king* who sits at a *small table*. One pearl is lumpy, bumpy, shaped like a potato, an **irregular pearl**, and it wobbles off course every throw. It bounces off the table and the king crowns it his favourite **irregular pearl**.

The {King} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Hut}, where a *tree* is growing straight out of the chimney, heavy with *fruit*. He counts aloud: one *tree*, two *trees*, using the royal **counter for trees** at every trunk. Fruit rains onto his crown with each number, because the **counter for trees** only works if you shout it.

The {Chef} hides under the {Trapdoor} at the {Funfair} until the security guard dozes off, then takes **advantage of** the moment. A *runner* with *thick hair* bolts past, and the Chef grabs the long hair like a tow rope and waterskis behind him through the rides, **taking advantage** of a free trip to the candy floss stall.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Stadium} into a workshop where an *open crate* overflows with tools. A grizzled **craftsman** tosses him an *axe*, and the juggler, juggling three axes, carves a whole wooden grandstand in seconds. The crowd above roars; the old **craftsman** nods and hands him an apron.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, balancing a *brimming cup* on a *dish* on her head. Every breath pours in more tea until the cup is **filled** past the brim and floods down the steps. The boxers paddle in the ring, now **filled** with tea to the ropes.

The {Wizard} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} treehouse waves his wand and a *grandpa* appears in a rocking chair, beard down to his knees. The **old man** rocks so hard he launches into the canopy, swinging vine to vine and yelling "In my day!" Monkeys gather to applaud the fastest **old man** in the jungle.

The {Chef} paces up and down the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse}, clutching his *heart* as *autumn* leaves pour in and bury his soufflé. He can only **worry**: will it rise, will it sink, will the boats float away? He **worries** so loudly that the leaves blow off the soufflé in a gust of sighs.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Casino}, and a giant *eye* on the roulette wheel stares back. In one *eyeblink*, the chips vanish, the dealer vanishes, and the Sheriff's hat vanishes. Everything happens in a **blink**, so the Sheriff keeps his eyes propped open with toothpicks, terrified to **blink** again.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} cradles a tiny *baby* in red boxing gloves. The **infant** squirms out of her arms, hops into the ring below, and knocks out the heavyweight champion with one wobbly punch. The referee counts to ten while the **infant** naps on the champion's belly.

The {Shepherd} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} and a *dutiful son* climbs out carrying his old father piggyback. He pours dad's tea, combs his beard, shoos cats off his lap, all with a deep bow. The cats are so moved by such **filial piety** they start carrying their own mothers around, purring with **filial piety**.

The {Juggler} in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} juggles a book until one *page* tears loose and wraps around his **neck** like a scarf. It keeps growing, printing more and more, until his **neck** is as long as a giraffe's and his head bonks the ring lights above.

The {Tailor} in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} looks up at a *standing person* balanced in the *attic* hatch. "**If** you jump, I'll catch you; **if** you don't, I'll sew you a parachute." The person jumps, the Tailor stitches madly, and the parachute pops open one inch above the floor.

The {Jockey} gallops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} straight into a river, spraying *water drops*, and uses a *snapped stick* as an oar. He paddles his horse south along the coast until he reaches **Zhejiang**, where tea pickers wave from green hills. "Welcome to **Zhejiang**!" they cry, handing him a soggy towel.

The {Lifeguard} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Stadium} into a grand *palace*, landing on the queen's cake. A *small speech bubble* floats from the queen's lips: "We **excuse** you." The Lifeguard bows, slips on frosting, flattens a second cake, and the bubble sighs: "We **excuse** you again."

The {Baker} slams the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} as a sandstorm hits, then piles *grass* and old *rags* over his trays of bread to **shield** them. Sand pings off the heap like hail. When the storm passes, the loaves are perfect, and he wears the rags as a cape to **shield** himself from praise.

The {Chef} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and slides down a giant *skewer* like a firepole, glowing in the *sun rays* pouring through the roof. Everything goes **smooth**: the kebabs glide off, the planes glide out, and the Chef's moustache is buttered perfectly **smooth**.

The {Zookeeper} pops out of the {Trapdoor} in the {Jungle} with a gift: a glittering *shell* balanced on a bamboo *steamer*. She bows and **presents** it to a gorilla. The gorilla opens the steamer, finds dumplings, and **presents** her with a banana in return, very formally.

The {Ninja} lands on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach}, where a *woman* and a *nun* are teaching a little **girl** to fly a kite. The ninja flips, the kite tangles in her sword, and the **girl** laughs so hard she floats up with the kite and waves goodbye.

The {Sheriff} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} hears a chirp in a pot of *grass* growing out of warm *sand*. A green **katydid** pops up, sings "katy-did, katy-didn't" and sprays sand in his eye. He arrests the **katydid**, but it hops away into the steam room.

The {Wizard} plunges through the {Trapdoor} into the {Lake} and surfaces in a uniform with brass buttons: a military *officer*. He salutes the fish, who line up in ranks. The **officer** inspects them, the frogs sound bugles, and the lake has never been so well drilled by an **officer**.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} and *icicles* sprout from his drill. An arctic wind from the *east* howls, and the whole lagoon begins to **freeze** with a crackle. Flamingos stop mid-step, the waves **freeze** into glass curls, and the Dentist ice-skates out.

The {Gardener} trips through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *teetering man* wobbles in a queue. A *kicking foot* swings out of nowhere and taps his knee, and down he goes: everyone has to **kneel**. Patients, nurses and the receptionist all **kneel** in a row, waiting for their names.

The {Chef} in the {Basement} by the {Swamp} rides a *horse* straight at a locked *gate*. He bellows, the horse snorts, and they **charge** through in an explosion of splinters and frogs. The swamp creatures cheer and **charge** after him, waving lily pads.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool}, where *grass* grows on every step and a slow *crawler* drags a bunch of **grapes**. The pirate swipes one, it bursts purple all over his beard, and the crawler squeaks "Portugal!" and waddles off with the rest of the **grapes**.

The {Hunter} creeps through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse}, but he hears *footsteps* **behind** him. He spins: nothing. He tiptoes on: *footsteps*. Every time he looks, a duck in fluffy slippers is standing right **behind** him, whistling innocently and hiding a rowing oar behind its back.

The {Chef} tumbles down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and lands under a *cliff* where his **kitchen** is carved into the rock face. Pots hang from stalactites, the oven is a cave, and the sink is the pool itself. Swimmers drift through his **kitchen** asking for lunch.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} meets a *bird* wearing shining *armour*: a **duck** knight. It quacks a battle cry and waddles off the edge, armour clanking, and belly-flops into the hot tub. The Yogi takes up arms beside the brave **duck**.

The {Dentist} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} does a *headstand* on the weathervane, the very **top** of the building. Coins tumble out of his pockets onto the traders below. From the **top**, upside down, he shouts "Open wide!" to the entire city.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} sees a messy *kitchen* sliding down the *road* below and the inspector coming. He flings a tablecloth over the whole kitchen to **cover up** the mess. The inspector lifts a corner, a pot falls on his foot, and the Jockey **covers up** that too.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} into a *cozy room* made of driftwood. A *small speech bubble* floats over each guest saying "friend!" They hug, trade sandwiches, and knit a scarf a mile long out of **friendship**. The sea rolls in, but the **friendship** floats.

The {Jockey} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} into a **ditch** where the *soil* has been dug away and a little *river* rushes past. His horse uses the ditch as a water slide; children follow on inflatables. Soon the whole fair queues for the **ditch**.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} next to a *coat stand* with a giant *mouth*. "Please, please!" the mouth wails, "Take off this hat!" It **implores** every visitor until the Yogi lifts the hat, and the stand sighs in relief, and then **implores** her for a scarf.

The {Lifeguard} on the {Staircase} of the {Casino} blows her whistle at a chaotic pile of chips. She starts to **arrange** them into a *neat stack*, then another, then a tower that reaches the chandelier. Gamblers gasp; she **arranges** the cards, the dice and even the dealer's eyebrows.

The {Pirate} crashes through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and meets a *pioneer* with a machete. Together they hack through the jungle to **open up** a new trail. The pioneer clears trees, the pirate clears coconuts, and the island is **opened up** for ice cream stands by lunch.

The {Lifeguard} lies on a *sickbed* on the {Staircase} of the {Youth Hostel} with a lump on her arm. The doctor removes the **tumor** and hands it back as a *keepsake* in a jar. She names the **tumor** Gerald and puts it on the hostel shelf, where backpackers take photos with it.

The {Sailor} in the {Basement} of the {Tower} hosts a family dinner. A *woman* and an *elder* argue over the dumplings: it's his **sister-in-law** and grandma. The **sister-in-law** wins, launches a dumpling across the room and it lands in the sailor's soup.

The {Tailor} on the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} finds the steps have melted into a grassy *hillside*, and a *serpent* slithers down the **slope**. The tailor grabs its tail and they toboggan down the **slope**, crashing into stacks of fabric at the bottom.

The {King} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Swamp} and lands inside a huge *picture frame* nailed to a *tree*. Frogs line up to admire the royal portrait. The king, stuck in the **frame**, poses grandly, while the swamp hangs the **frame** in its gallery.

The {Tailor} on the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} pins a nametag onto every guest. A *small speech bubble* pops from each tag announcing "Hello, my surname is Tan!" Everyone in the **surname Tan** family hugs; the tailor soon realises he too has the **surname Tan**.

The {Hunter} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} finds a golden *shrine hall*, where coins rain down from the roof. Every offering returns double, and the hunter's pockets overflow. He's so **prosperous** that monkeys open a bank, and the jungle has never been so **prosperous**.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} tosses *gold coins* in the air, but a sleepy *yawn* from a guest blows them back. She bows deeply to the guest to show she **respects** him. The guest yawns again; she **respects** that too, and does a quiet cheer.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} boathouse sits in a plain wooden *shed* that is totally **ordinary**: one chair, one broom, one sock. Tourists come to see the famous yogi, and she does nothing special but drink tea. They leave thrilled by how **ordinary** it is.

The {Cheerleader} bursts out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} carrying *two sheaves* of wheat, then knocks over the banker. She does a giant *yawn* by accident, which looks rude, so she **apologizes** with a cheer: "S-O-R-R-Y!" The banker **apologizes** too, for some reason.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} rides along a *winding path* through tall *grass*. He discovers a carpet of **zoysia grass** so soft that the horse lies down and bees nap on it too. The Jockey rolls a bale of **zoysia grass** home for his lawn.

The {Hunter} in the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} kneels by a dark *hole* in the floor and puts his *mouth* to it. He lets out a mighty **roar**, and from deep below comes an even bigger one back. Boats rattle, oars leap off the walls, and a walrus pokes its head up to **roar** that it is trying to sleep.

The {Firefighter} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} waters a *seedbed* with her hose, and sprouts pop up instantly. "I **just** planted those!" she cries, as a beanstalk crashes through the ceiling into the deep end. Swimmers climb down it, saying they **just** came for a swim.

The {Sheriff} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} hangs his laundry, but his *shirt* has grown *bristles* like a hedgehog. Every **garment** on the line sprouts spikes and starts crawling toward the chimney. The Sheriff lassoes them, puts on the prickliest **garment**, and itches all the way to the saloon.

The {Tailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} stretches out a *helping hand* and opens it, and a *caught bird* flutters free. Its wings **spread out** wide, then wider, until they cover the whole roof like a picnic blanket. The Tailor **spreads out** his sandwiches on the feathers and invites the pigeons to lunch.

The {Yogi} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a **banquet** hall under a glass *roof*. A *sunbathing woman* lies stretched across the dining table between roast turkeys and jellies. Guests politely pass the gravy over her, and she declares it the sunniest **banquet** of the season.

The {Jockey} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} faces a huge *mouth* nailed to the wall that won't stop talking. It **instructs** all his *kinfolk* at once: "Grandma, hold the reins! Uncle, mind the hurdles! Cousins, swim in a straight line!" The kinfolk obey, and the mouth **instructs** the goldfish next.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} opens his silk *robe* to reveal a painted *bullseye* right over his heart. Arrows of emotion thud into it one after another: love, fear, homesickness. Each arrow plays a little tune that sings out his **inner feelings**, and the lagoon weeps at his **inner feelings**.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} carries a *woman* who refuses to touch the ground; she walks only on golden *stilts*. Cats fan her, waiters peel her grapes, and she sighs if the cushion is too soft. She is the most **pampered** guest ever, and the cats are jealous: they wanted to be **pampered**.

The {Sheriff} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} uses giant *tongs* to pick up a whole *hillside* of yellow loess and set it on the map. The hillside unfolds into terraces, cave homes and a terracotta army marching out of the soil. "Welcome to **Shaanxi**," salutes a clay soldier, and the Sheriff stamps **Shaanxi** in his passport.

The {Juggler} in the {Basement} of the {Museum} juggles an *arrow* and a *set square*, measuring every statue as it flies past. Anyone crooked must obey the **rule**: straighten up! Statues snap upright, frames line up, and the juggler chalks the last **rule** on the wall at a perfect right angle.

The {Pirate} in the {Basement} of the {Pool} finds a muddy **river bank** where the tiles should be, thick with swaying *cattail*. He pokes his cutlass into the reeds and a family of otters scolds him. He builds a hammock between two cattails and naps on the **river bank** till the tide comes in.

The {Yogi} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} and a *small speech bubble* floats above a sleeping vampire's lips: "Who's there?" The vampire flashes a *fang*, the Yogi is **astonished**, and so is the vampire, who has never seen a person in a lotus pose before. Both stare, utterly **astonished**, in the steam.

The {Sailor} in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} grabs a *follower* by the *ear* and starts to **raise up** the poor fellow toward the ceiling. The follower's ear stretches like rubber and pops through the floorboards above. Everyone in the lagoon **raises up** their own ears in alarm.

The {Lifeguard} in the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} hears a crash: a stack of crates bursts and an army of *fruit* comes rolling out, every banana with its *shirt* torn off. Peeled, they run around totally **naked**, shrieking. She chases them with towels, but the oranges peel too, and soon the whole warehouse is **naked**.

The {Baker} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and finds an *amber* lump glowing beside a mossy *stone*. He tosses them into the sea, and the whole bay turns **bluish green**, like mint jelly. He dunks a croissant in it; now his croissants are **bluish green** and wildly popular.

The {Tsar} on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} raises a giant *helping hand* and karate-chops a *lofty peak* in the distance. The mountain crumbles, avalanches tumble, and he moves on to **destroy** the clock, the magazine rack and the 'please wait' sign. Patients cheer: he will **destroy** waiting forever.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} gets paid in bundles of *firewood* tied with *grass*. Every month his **salary** grows taller, until his stack is higher than the chimney. The innkeeper burns half of it for heat, and the Shepherd demands his **salary** be paid in sheep instead.

The {Lifeguard} jogs up the {Staircase} of the {Inn} swinging a watering can over a little indoor *grove* of lemon trees. She **sprinkles** *water drops* on everything: the trees, the guests, the cat, the wedding cake. The innkeeper opens an umbrella, so she crouches and **sprinkles** him from below until his slippers float.

The {Chef} in the {Basement} of the {Beehive} has honey dripping from one *ear* after he licked the queen's private jar. A furious bee holds up a *stop sign* in his face. He blushes crimson with **shame**, and the bees hum a song of his **shame** for a week.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} sits under the *moon* with *crossed legs*, but he has spilled **glue** all over himself. His legs stick together, his juggling balls stick to his hands, and a cat sticks to his head. The moon itself gets stuck to the chimney with **glue**.

The {Tailor} on the {Staircase} of the {Pool} finds a *lying man* sprawled across the steps and a *busy man* sharpening knives above him. The busy man is the **butcher**, who mistakes everything for sausages. The tailor quickly stitches a sign reading "not meat" onto the lying man, and the **butcher** chops a pool noodle instead.

The {Ghost} floats up the {Staircase} of the {Hut} and finds a *spearman* guarding a white *bird*. With a honk, the **goose** grabs the spear, chases the spearman out the door and hisses at the Ghost. The ghost flees, terrified for the first time in his afterlife, while the **goose** takes over the hut.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} sets a *small table* with a single *side dish*: one pea. He is so **starving** he juggles it to make it seem bigger. Seagulls swoop and grab it, and he chases them across the sand, still **starving**.

The {Pirate} pops his head up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and his *eye* locks onto a *cut cake* on the dining table. He **longs for** that slice so hard that his eye pops out of its socket on a spring and floats toward it. Every pirate in the house **longs for** a slice too.

The {Baker} on the {Staircase} of the {Fort} looks up at the *moon* as a blazing *comet* swoops by. He stretches his **neck** to see it, longer, longer, until his **neck** is coiled up the staircase like a hose and his chin rests on the battlements.

The {Hunter} on the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} sees a glowing *bug* hammering on a tiny *workbench*. It is painting stripes: red, orange, yellow, green, building a **rainbow** one plank at a time. When it's done, the bug slides down its **rainbow** into the lagoon with a splash.

The {Tsar} bursts through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} wearing a crown of *feathers*. He knights a chess *pawn*, which turns **emerald green** and glows. Every chair, magazine and patient turns **emerald green** too, and the receptionist asks if anyone has an appointment for envy.

The {Baker} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} canopy hears a rumble, and an *avalanche* of snow and dough comes thundering down the mountain. Trees, monkeys and bread rolls tumble as everything starts to **collapse**. The Baker surfs the avalanche on a baking tray, and the jungle **collapses** into a giant pile of bread.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and opens a giant *shell* to find the bank clerk inside with *long hair* tangled in ribbons. She is counting every coin he owes on his **account**, with the long hair writing figures on the walls like a quill. "Your **account** is overdrawn," she says, clicking the shell shut.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, which is now flooded and covered with *grass* and green *pond weed*. Tiny round leaves of **duckweed** float everywhere and stick to his boots. He tries to box an opponent, but slips on the **duckweed** and floats away like a lily pad.

The {Firefighter} slides down the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} lodge and crashes into a stranger: a *chance meeting* with her long-lost twin. They both drop their hoses, stare, and laugh. What are the odds they **meet by chance** in a jungle? They plan to **meet by chance** again next week.

The {Jockey} pops out of the {Trapdoor} at the {Swan Pond} and sells *two sheaves* of wheat to a swan for a gleaming *shell*. He sells more, and more, until he **earns** a whole sack of shells. The swans start a bank, and now the Jockey **earns** interest too.

The {Chef} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} treehouse watches the roof sag. He lifts a *palm* tree and a *helping hand* to **prop up** the ceiling. The tree groans, and monkeys hang from it, but it holds. The Chef **props up** his soufflé the same way.

The {Shepherd} on the {Staircase} of the {Stadium} glues *feathers* onto every *sheep* in his flock. One by one they take a run-up and **soar** over the crowd, baa-ing like geese. The fans cheer as the sheep **soar** past the scoreboard into the clouds.

The {Chef} slams open the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and a *standing person* rises under a blazing *double sun*, shouting "Let's begin!" She **initiates** the first ever parade of flying saucepans, and the planes follow behind. Inspired, the Chef **initiates** a new tradition: pancakes tossed from every cockpit.

The {Magician} on the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} pulls a *silk thread* out of his sleeve, then a sheet of *silk cloth*, then more and more, in a **continuous** stream. It wraps round the bankers, the vault and the stairs. The flow is **continuous**, without end.

The {Hunter} on the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} watches a *prowling dog* sniff around a velvet-robed *marquis*. The marquis pulls off his wig and reveals he's a **monkey**! He leaps onto the dog's back and they ride off, the **monkey** waving his crown.

The {King} on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} keeps an *antique* potted *tree*, but he forgot to water it for a century. It is **withered**, crackly and grey, its leaves falling like old paper. He hurls it into the pool; it gulps the whole pool dry, splutters, and stays exactly as **withered** as before.

The {Wizard} on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} stands at a *workbench* with a *follower* mixing potions. One potion splashes on the follower and he becomes a **wizard** too, with a pointy hat. Now two **wizards** argue on the roof about who stole the wand.

The {Jockey} gallops onto the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} and swings a giant *spotlight* toward the night sky. The beam is so **bright** that owls put on sunglasses and the moon files a complaint. He aims it at his horse, who poses proudly, glowing **bright** enough to be seen from the next country.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} lodge watches a *standing heart* jog toward the *goal line* on tiny legs, about to win the race. Just before the line it stops dead and stares at him. The Jockey is so **startled** he falls off his horse, and the horse, equally **startled**, sits on him.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mint} lets *water drops* fall from her fingertips into the *abyss* below the building. The drops keep falling and falling and never splash, filling a **deep pool** that swallows coins, chairs and an entire printing press. She dives in; three days later she is still sinking through the **deep pool**.

The {Tsar} flings open the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} and freezing air pours out, hanging *icicles* from every beam. All the shivering boatmen, ducks and fishermen **gather together** in a big furry huddle around his fur coat. The Tsar sighs, opens his coat, and they all **gather together** inside it.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} watches a *page boy* carry a silver tray of *water drops* down the hill. The drops trickle off the tray and form a tiny babbling **creek** that winds between the sandcastles. The sheep line up to drink, and the page boy builds a toy bridge across the **creek**.

The {Chef} in the {Basement} of the {Casino} bets everything on two *worms* racing through the *springtime* garden of a flower pot. He cheers, sweats, and then realises the worms are just napping. "That was **stupid**," he whispers, and bets again; even the worms think he is **stupid**.

The {Chef} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} before a *small altar*, holding a tennis *racket* in perfect silence. A ball flies at his head; he does not move, and it stops in mid-air. This is **Zen** tennis: no swing, no score, no worries. The butler bows to the master of **Zen**.

The {Chef} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} stands before a locked *gate* and waves a tennis *racket* like a pointer. He **explains** to a class of potatoes exactly how a gate works: hinges, latch, push. The potatoes look blank, so he **explains** again, louder, then demonstrates by smashing through it.

The {Wizard} pops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and a *king* stands under a blazing *sun*, scattering seeds. Plants burst up through the concrete, airplanes sprout leaves, and the place is **flourishing** like a jungle. Mechanics harvest pineapples from the propellers; business has never been so **flourishing**.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} and finds a *monkey* has moved in under the glass *roof* of the dinosaur hall. It hangs its laundry on the T. rex, sets up a bed in the ribs and **resides** there happily. The guard tries to evict it, but the monkey now **resides** in the guard's hat too.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} temple, through tall *grass*, and finds stems of *rattan* winding up the banister. He snips them and weaves a **rattan** chair, a **rattan** hat and a **rattan** handbag on the spot. The vines keep growing and weave the Tailor into the chair.

The {Firefighter} in the {Basement} of the {Lake} house opens an *open crate* and out flies a **bandit** with *spread wings* made of stolen bedsheets. He swoops off with her helmet and her hose. She sprays him down, and the soggy **bandit** crash-lands in the lake.

The {Sailor} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} opens a black **umbrella** indoors and a tiny *person* drops out of it, then another, then twenty, all holding their own tiny umbrellas. They float around the cellar like dandelion seeds. The Sailor closes his **umbrella** and they all rain on his head.

The {Baker} on the {Rooftop} by the {Lake} carves a huge *stone* into a **monument** of himself holding a baguette. He fans the dust away with a paper *fan*, and the statue sneezes. Fishermen row past to salute the **monument**, which keeps sneezing flour.

The {Ninja} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} where a *pointing finger* on the wall orders "That way!" A huge *helping hand* reaches out to **shift** a crate, then a forklift, then the Ninja. Every time the finger points, the hand **shifts** the whole warehouse an inch to the left.

The {Cheerleader} on the {Staircase} of the {Youth Club} shakes pom-poms in front of a *king* who lives in a tiny *palace* carved from **fine jade**. He offers her a green cup that rings like a bell. She drops it; it bounces, unbroken, because it is the **fine jade** that never shatters.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} reads an *edict scroll* by the *moon*: all horses must lose **fat**. His horse gasps, hides a doughnut, and starts jogging around the hive. The bees, also guilty of **fat**, buzz along behind with honey on their breath.

The {Hunter} in the {Basement} by the {Swamp} says he caught a crocodile with his bare hands, and a *small speech bubble* floats from his mouth. It drifts off into the *wasteland* and dissolves. It was a **lie**; every **lie** he tells drifts into the wasteland, now a gray field of bubbles.

The {King} in the {Basement} of the {Island} fort sits before a *finished meal*, and his *standing heart* leaps up on the table. It delivers an **impassioned** speech about pudding, pounding its chest. The king weeps, gives a standing ovation, and orders seconds; never was a lunch so **impassioned**.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} through tall *grass* and meets a serene **bodhisattva** sitting cross-legged on the diving board. A *spitting mouth* hurls insults and peanuts at her, but she just smiles. The peanuts turn into lotuses mid-air; the Pirate kneels to the **bodhisattva** and surrenders his cutlass.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower}, where *grass* sprouts from a *pottery* jar and vines spiral up. He picks one fat purple **grape**, then sews it a tiny waistcoat. The **grape** puts it on, bows, and rolls down every step to the bottom.

The {Sheriff} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} finds a *prowling dog* in a classroom with a strict *teacher*. The teacher shakes a mane onto the dog and it grows into a roaring **lion**. The bees flee, the Sheriff tips his hat, and the **lion** sits down obediently to learn arithmetic.

The {Juggler} on the {Staircase} of the {Ice Rink} finds a *crouching man* scraping the ice with an enormous *helping hand* like a digger bucket. Together they **excavate** a hole and find a frozen mammoth wearing skates. They **excavate** deeper still and pull out a penguin who complains they've woken him a thousand years early.

The {Chef} on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} watches a sneaky *helping hand* steal a *pinch* of salt from his neighbour's pot. He **copies** the move exactly, and the neighbour **copies** him back. Soon fifty chefs on the roof are pinching salt from each other in a perfect circle, and nobody's soup gets any saltier.

The {Lifeguard} in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} climbs a *mountain* that rises through the floor. A *herald* trumpets from the peak, and more mountains pop up in a row: a whole **mountain range**. She slides down the slopes, and the boxers hike the **mountain range** to the ring.

The {Yogi} on the {Rooftop} of the {Dunes} watches an *army* march round and round her in circles under the hot *sun*. She spins her head to follow them until she's utterly **dizzy**. She topples into the sand, and the army, also **dizzy**, falls on top of her.

The {Dentist} in the {Basement} of the {Island} lighthouse chases a *servant* who stole his drill down a winding *road*. He sprints, leaps over a crab, and finally **catches** him by the collar. The servant laughs and says "**catch** me if you can" again.

The {King} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} swings his sword at a *stone* that won't stop yawning a huge *yawn*. He **chops** it in two, and both halves yawn. He **chops** again, and soon a dozen yawning pebbles fill the basement.

The {Tailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} sticks his *helping hand* into a tall *pottery* jar and starts to **fish out** treasures: a sock, a goldfish, a rubber chicken, a tuba. The jar keeps giving, so he **fishes out** a whole marching band.

The {Dentist} on the {Staircase} by the {Beach} meets a *prowling dog* in an official hat warming its paws by a *campfire*. It is the **low official** of the beach, stamping forms for sandcastle permits. The dentist fixes its teeth, and the grateful **low official** stamps him a free pass.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} by the {Beach} sees a *woodcutter* splitting logs under the blazing *sun*. Every chop is crisp, every splinter **distinct**, every shadow sharp as a knife. Even the sheep, normally fuzzy, become **distinct**, outlined in black like a cartoon.

The {Hunter} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} hangs a *torn net* on a *drying rack* and finds one strange fish stuck in it, glowing purple with three tails. It is so **rare** that scientists burst in with cameras and microphones. The fish winks; it knows it is **rare**.

The {Wizard} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} grabs a fleeing *dodger* with a *helping hand* conjured out of smoke. "**Pull back**!" he yells, and the dodger is yanked off his feet like a rubber band. The dodger tries again; the Wizard **pulls back** harder.

The {Pirate} on the {Staircase} by the {Beach} feels a pain under his ribs. Under the *moon*, a doctor waves a *fan* over him and pulls out a **spleen** the size of a melon. The pirate looks at his **spleen**, salutes it, and puts it back in his treasure chest.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} decides to ride a *boat* instead of a horse. He saddles it, cracks the whip, and gallops the **boat** down the roof tiles straight into the lake, splashing ducks. He wins the regatta by a nose, still riding his **boat** like a racehorse.

The {Chef} on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} sees a wise *sage* lying on a *sickbed*, sighing, **infatuated** with the queen bee. He writes love poems in honey, hums bee songs and can't eat. The Chef brings soup, but the sage is too **infatuated** to notice.

The {Tsar} pops up through the {Trapdoor} on the {Island} and sees islanders making a *sacrifice* of *grass* bundles at a shrine. Each bundle has a name tag: **surname Cai**. The whole island shares the **surname Cai**, and they invite the Tsar to join the family.

The {Juggler} in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} juggles a *knife* with two blades stuck together at the *front*, and they snap shut: a pair of **scissors**! He cuts banknotes into paper dolls, which dance across the floor. The bankers chase him, but he snips their ties with the **scissors**.

The {Juggler} in the {Basement} by the {Beach} hoists the full *moon* onto his back and staggers around, groaning and creaking. His **spine** bends like a xylophone, each vertebra ringing a different note. He plays a sea shanty on his own **spine** with two lobster claws, and the crabs dance a conga around him.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} villa strings a giant *bow* with a garden hose. She shoots tulips like arrows, and they land in neat rows across the lagoon. Fish sit up to admire the champion of the **bow**, and she bows with her **bow**.

The {Lifeguard} in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} finds a *freeloader* sprawled on a sofa, with a *standing heart* doing all his chores. He is so **lazy** that even his heart has to stand up to fetch the crisps. She blows her whistle; he is too **lazy** to hear it.

The {Chef} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} stabs a giant *fork* into the clouds and twirls them like spaghetti. He drops the clouds on the steam bath, where guests twirl their own. Every towel has a **fork** sticking out of it, and the Chef eats the sunset with a **fork**.

The {Gardener} in the {Basement} of the {Wine Cellar} jams a *spare part* into a barrel with her *helping hand*, and the barrel starts rolling. She steers it, **turning** left and right between the wine racks, and it shoots up the ramp. At the top, she has to **turn** to avoid the butler.

The {Ninja} sneaks up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} past a portrait whose *mouth* has turned to face *south*. It won't stop **mumbling**: shopping lists, grudges, soup recipes, the weather in Antarctica. The ninja clamps a hand over it, but it simply **mumbles** louder through his fingers, now giving away his hiding place.

The {Lifeguard} on the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} meets a *standing person* holding a *torch*: her new **colleague**. Together they patrol the café, rescuing cats from milk saucers. The **colleague** lights the way, she blows the whistle, and the cats elect them employees of the month.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mint} holds a *helping hand* out with a *silkworm* in its palm. The silkworm spins a gold coin and he decides to **donate** it. Coins pour out of the mint, and the juggler **donates** them to every passing pigeon.

The {Zookeeper} in the {Basement} of the {Beehive} meets a tall *woman* in a beekeeper hat: her **older sister**, here to boss her around. "Wrong honey, wrong hive, wrong hat," the **older sister** says, as bees swarm her and obey only her.

The {Sailor} on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} tries to nap in his hammock, but a *flea* riding a tiny *horse* gallops up and down his nose. It leaps, bites and trumpets to **disturb** him all night long. He swats, misses, and swats again; by dawn the flea has recruited friends to **disturb** the whole town.

The {Tailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and uses a *helping hand* to push a *stone* wall outward. The warehouse **expands**, inch by inch, then mile by mile, and crates multiply. He keeps pushing, and the warehouse **expands** into the next town.

The {Wizard} on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} hut puts a *no sign* on the *goal line* of the beach football pitch. A ball hits it and it tilts **askew**. Then the palm trees, the hut and the Wizard's hat all go **askew**, and the whole island leans.

The {Jockey} on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} visits a *fortune teller* who throws sticky *rice* at him. Every grain **sticks**: on his nose, on his saddle, on his horse. The fortune teller says "You'll be together forever," as the horse **sticks** to the chimney.

The {Baker} in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} sets up a *tripod* over a fallen *tree* and carves it into a gigantic **handle** for his rolling pin. It is longer than the ring itself. When the bell rings he pole-vaults out of the basement on the **handle**, flattening the champion like a pancake.

The {King} on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} canopy sees a man in a *high collar* digging *soil* furiously below. He has dug a **pit** so deep that monkeys use it as an elevator. The King jumps in to inspect it and the **pit** echoes "your majesty" all the way down.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} and lands on a strange *hillside*, clutching a *banknote* covered in faces he has never seen. Every flag, coin and cow here is **unfamiliar**. He tries to make the banknote vanish; it comes back as a purple goat, equally **unfamiliar**, chewing his top hat.

The {Jockey} in the {Basement} of the {Island} crawls into a *cave* where a *jack-in-the-box* springs up and blocks the way. The tunnel is so **narrow** he has to fold his horse in half. They squeeze through the **narrow** gap with a pop like a cork.

The {Shepherd} on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} climbs a *lookout* tower and sees *water drops* falling into a long river. He follows it south to the land of chili peppers: **Hunan**! He eats one pepper and steams so much he could power the stadium; **Hunan** cheers.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} and finds a *cracked shell* glowing on the floor. The cracks spell a message: tomorrow it will rain carrots. It's an **omen**! Next morning carrots bounce off every roof, his horse gallops around catching them, and from then on believes every single **omen**, even fortune cookies.

The {Yogi} on the {Staircase} of the {Spa} climbs a *mountain* trail to the *cliff edge* and balances on one toe over a **precipice**. The steam swirls below like clouds. She does a headstand at the very lip of the **precipice**, and a goat applauds.

The {Juggler} on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} sees a *horse* strutting on golden *stilts*, nose in the air. It is so **arrogant** it refuses to talk to cats, then trips over a kitten. Still **arrogant**, it pretends it meant to fall.

The {Sheriff} on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} chases an *assassin* on a runaway bathtub. At the last second he jams a *standing knife* into the roof to **brake**, sparks flying. The tub stops at the edge; the assassin, without a **brake**, flies into the pool.

The {Baker} on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} cracks a long **whip** of braided *rawhide* that takes a *shortcut* through the air, zigzagging between chimneys. Crack! It snatches coins from the bankers' fingers and stacks them in neat towers. Then he whirls the **whip** into a bowl and whisks cream so fast it turns to butter.
